questions.question: What is the primary purpose of COLB tokenization?
options: Bringing real-world assets to the blockchain
questions.explanation: COLB focuses on bringing real-world assets to the blockchain through tokenization.

questions.question: Tokenization makes financial products accessible only to institutional investors.
questions.explanation: False. Tokenization actually democratizes access, making institutional-grade products available to everyone through fractional ownership.

questions.question: Which challenges does traditional finance face? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Traditional finance faces limited access, illiquidity, and high costs. Lack of transparency (not too much) is actually a problem.

questions.question: What is one of the main benefits of COLB's approach?
questions.explanation: COLB democratizes access to institutional-grade financial products through fractional ownership.

questions.question: COLB uses blockchain technology to provide real-time ownership records.
questions.explanation: True. COLB leverages blockchain for transparency and real-time, verifiable ownership records.
